say:1:1130617001:1.source_cn: 当然，这是从锈锚港进口的火器，整个咸水镇都找不到比这更...

say:3:1130617003:1.text: The fact that they all use our weapons exclusively speaks volumes!
say:3:1130617003:1.source_cn: 这些老家伙都只用我们的枪械，说明我们商品的品质绝对值得信赖！

say:4:1130617004:1.text: Just look at the expert craftsmanship! From the intricate inlays on the stock to the hair-trigger and expertly calibrated sights, you're looking at the epitome of perfection!
